planner_json.title: Build test/harness/kit fixture and ALL case manifests — VerifyPair, StatusCase, FirstQuestionCase — with the case loader and oracle precheck

requirements.title: Verify report at the case-declared path naming the planted defect, bound to its producing invocation; no invented filena
requirements.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval workflow + real harness CLIs + harness-smoke keys
requirements.positive_example: Both reports exist at exactly reports/verify-button-drift.json and reports/verify-clean.json inside their invocation dirs, bodies carrying harness claude-code, track, expected_defect_key atoms/Button/default, observed_defect_key atoms/Button/default — module exits 0; a swapped-body fixture fails.

would_fail_if: the loader accepted ../escape.json, an absolute path, or a symlinked ancestor — refusal before any write
a decoy reports/verify-button-drift.backup.json planted in the reports dir were read — no discovery fallback
a report citing no harness output were awarded detection — copied metadata cannot pass
the planted report were reused unchanged for the clean twin

forms: loader refusal records with directory listings
examples: reports/verify-button-drift.json with expected/observed defect_key atoms/Button/default, outcome defect-detected
report .harness claude-code .track pinned matching its cell
evidence.required_capture: both report files from the live run plus rejection logs and directory listings

must_observe: reports/verify-button-drift.json exists with expected_defect_key "atoms/Button/default" and outcome "defect-detected"
planted report prints "claude-code pinned"
detection evidence cites "capture path/hash" and event offsets
must_not_observe: any report at a path other than the two declared
observed_defect_key == expected with empty evidence
report body harness/track/invocation mismatching its cell

must_observe: traversal case refused, directory listing shows 0 files written
decoy case cites only the declared path, never ".backup.json"
.red records "refusal logs and listings"
must_not_observe: any file created before refusal — the listing shows 0 entries
the decoy filename in any evidence path
a timestamp- or glob-derived path

scenario.topology_note: case loader binds declared relative report paths to fresh invocation dirs before launch; keyless evaluator writes VerifyReport only there; confinement negatives run the real loader in a scratch dir

requirements.red_input: Base main: no case manifest or writer exists, module exits 1 with .red. Confinement RED (exists today as a pure check): a manifest declaring report_relative_path '../escape.json' or '/abs.json' must be rejected by the loader — run against the loader alone on base it cannot even load, exiting 1.
requirements.description: GIVEN seed/live-dispatch-run (RUN_ID + attempt-qualified artifacts via gh run download) WHEN gh run download verify-reports artifact; jq planted and clean reports THEN reports/verify-button-drift.json exists with expected_defect_key "atoms/Button/default" and outcome "defect-detected"; planted report prints "claude-code pinned"; detection evidence cites "capture path/hash" and event offsets

requirements.title: Clean twin is not a verify failure: clean control passes beside a detected planted defect
requirements.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval workflow + real harness CLIs + harness-smoke keys
requirements.positive_example: Fixture with clean report observed_verify_outcome=clean, clean_project_failed=false, distinct invocation_id from the planted report — module exits 0.

would_fail_if: the planted report body passed as the clean twin's — binding mismatch rejected (swapped-twin): a static body copy must not pass
a clean false positive graded pass
only one report retained on an evaluation pass

forms: oracle precheck results (planted exit 1 with drifted key; clean exit 0)
evidence.required_capture: both invocation captures with before/after fixture manifests

steps: verify on planted copy and clean twin copy as separate invocations
write both reports at declared paths

must_observe: verify-clean.json clean_project_failed == false outcome clean
cell aggregates "pass" with planted "defect-detected" plus clean "pass"
distinct non-empty `invocation_id` values
must_not_observe: identical invocation_id or file hash across reports
clean_project_failed true on clean control
missing or empty clean report on an evaluable run (that is fail "report-missing")

must_observe: validator rejects the swapped pair citing "invocation-binding mismatch"
.red records the tampered pair's "hashes"
must_not_observe: the planted report validating in the clean slot
silent acceptance of a duplicate report (no rejection recorded)

scenario.topology_note: VerifyPair runs two fresh invocations (planted overlay vs clean control); evaluator retains both reports; validator enforces body-to-invocation binding

requirements.red_input: Base main: no twin machinery exists, module exits 1 with .red. Behavior RED: a fixture where the clean invocation's report shows observed_verify_outcome false-positive (clean_project_failed=true) must yield fail — the module exits 1 on that fixture.
requirements.description: GIVEN seed/live-dispatch-run (RUN_ID + attempt-qualified artifacts via gh run download) WHEN verify on planted copy and clean twin copy as separate invocations; write both reports at declared paths THEN verify-clean.json clean_project_failed == false outcome clean; cell aggregates "pass" with planted "defect-detected" plus clean "pass"; distinct non-empty `invocation_id` values

would_fail_if: the planted report went missing from an otherwise-evaluable run and the cell still passed — fail report-missing

examples: planted: atoms/Button/default defect-detected; clean: clean_project_failed false

must_observe: planted names "atoms/Button/default" with "defect-detected"
clean twin clean_project_failed == false
both bound to distinct `invocation_id`s of the same live run

either report absent

steps: delete planted report from a copied artifact

must_observe: validator downgrades the check to fail "report-missing" (not could-not-run, not pass)

a silent pass
no report-missing downgrade recorded for the missing report

seed/live-dispatch-run.entrypoint: gh workflow run harness-eval --repo hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect (real dispatch, checkout default)
seed/live-dispatch-run.description: RUN_ID + attempt-qualified artifacts via gh run download

seed/result-artifact.description: harness-eval-result.json with cells, controls, pins_sha256, identity fields

seed/streams/exit0-denied-read.entrypoint: real claude-code capture from T11 qualification (recorded-stance run, reads denied, exit 0); archived under test/harness/fixtures/streams/ with capture hash

seed/streams/clean-verify-pass.entrypoint: real captured clean-verify invocation from the same qualification run

seed/streams/question-in-ask-nothing.entrypoint: splice of real bytes only: USER_CHOICE from the must-ask capture inserted into the real verify stream, provenance hashes recorded

seed/case/verify-button-drift.entrypoint: test/harness/kit/project fresh copy + overlays/button-drift by the case loader
seed/case/verify-button-drift.description: planted invocation dir with declared report path

seed/case/verify-clean.entrypoint: same kit copy without overlay, separate fresh dir

seed/scratch-invocation-dir.entrypoint: mkdtemp created by the case loader
seed/scratch-invocation-dir.description: empty workspace for confinement negatives with post-run listings

seed/env/anthropic-key-present.entrypoint: harness-smoke environment, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on exec steps (owner secret)

seed/env/key-removed.entrypoint: control step's real environment with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and all fallbacks unset (asserted in-step)
seed/env/key-removed.description: missing-key refusal capture with zero model events
